title: Hindu organizations protest in Bhopal over alleged cattle slaughter
seoTitle: Bhopal protest over alleged cattle slaughter

tea.why: Hindu organizations protested following the discovery of suspected cattle remains near a dairy in Bhopal.
tea.want: Protesters demanded strict punishment for the accused, the demolition of the dairy, and measures to prevent such incidents.
tea.changed: Oct 9: Activists staged a protest outside Kolar police station, and the municipal corporation demolished the dairy structure.

summary: Following the discovery of suspected cattle remains near a river in the Damkheda area of Bhopal, workers from Hindu organisations including Bajrang Dal and Vishwa Hindu Parishad staged a demonstration. Activists gathered at the Kolar police station to submit a memorandum demanding severe penalties for the accused, the removal of the dairy, and the seizure of vehicles involved. Police stated that three individuals were arrested under the Madhya Pradesh Cow Slaughter Prohibition Act. Amid the demonstrations, the Bhopal Municipal Corporation demolished the dairy structure in the presence of administrative and police officials while shifting seized cattle to a municipal pound. Authorities noted that further investigations are underway.
demands: Strict legal action against the accused
Seizure of the vehicle used to transport remains
Examination of call records to find other involved parties
response: Police stated they registered a case and arrested three suspects under the Madhya Pradesh Cow Slaughter Prohibition Act. The Bhopal Municipal Corporation demolished the dairy structure, and officials stated that an investigation and interrogation of the suspects are ongoing.

updates.text: Police and municipal officials demolished the dairy structure amid protests by workers of Hindu organisations.
Activists from Bajrang Dal and Vishwa Hindu Parishad staged a protest outside Kolar police station demanding strict action.
